components.text: Sign in to Railway. This guide uses an account token, which can access all resources your account can access. Workspace and project tokens cannot run the current-user query used by this test.

Open Account Settings → Tokens. Select No workspace to create an account token, and copy it into the protected field. Treat it as a broad account credential and revoke it in Railway when no longer needed.

Choose a Ragentic workspace and connection name. Test runs the provider-documented read-only me query and checks the returned account user ID. Save encrypts the token and offers a one-time connector export.
Independent integration for Railway API. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Railway.

"""
A reusable starting point for cloud agents: a configured disk snapshot plus environment variables, shared by everyone in an environment. Each save adds a version; new cloud agents start from the active one.
"""
type AgentBootstrap {
  """
  The version new agents start from. Null when no version is available to boot.
  """
  activeVersion: AgentBootstrapVersion
  createdAt: DateTime!

  """The environment this bootstrap belongs to."""
  environmentId: String!

  """Why the bootstrap is DEGRADED, when it is."""
  failureReason: String
  id: ID!

  """Unique within the environment."""
  name: String!

  """Whether new cloud agents can currently start from this bootstrap."""
  status: AgentBootstrapStatus!
  updatedAt: DateTime!
}

scalar AgentBootstrapManifest

input AgentBootstrapSaveInput {
  """
  The running cloud agent whose disk is captured as the new version. Omit to change only the name or variables of an existing bootstrap (`id` required): a variables change appends a version on the current snapshot instead of taking a new one.
  """
  cloudAgentId: String

  """
  An existing bootstrap to add the version to. Omit to create a new bootstrap named `name`.
  """
  id: String

  """
  A summary of what this version contains, for display: the startup script, notes, skill names, and the repositories checked out.
  """
  manifest: AgentBootstrapManifest

  """
  Name for a new bootstrap; required when `id` is omitted. With `id`, renames the bootstrap.
  """
  name: String

  """
  Changes to the bootstrap's variables, applied on top of the active version's: a string sets a variable, null removes it, and variables not mentioned are kept. Values may reference other variables with ${{...}} syntax.
  """
  variables: JSON
}

"""
Whether new cloud agents can start from a bootstrap. READY: the active version is ready to boot. SAVING: a version is still being captured. DEGRADED: the active version cannot be booted; see failureReason.
"""
enum AgentBootstrapStatus {
  DEGRADED
  READY
  SAVING
}

"""
A saved version of an agent bootstrap: a snapshot of a cloud agent's disk plus the variables that agents started from it receive.
"""
type AgentBootstrapVersion {
  """The cloud agent checkpoint holding this version's disk snapshot."""
  checkpoint: CloudAgentCheckpoint!
  createdAt: DateTime!
  id: ID!

  """
  A summary of what was captured (startup script, agent notes, skills, repositories), as reported when the version was saved. Informational only; the disk snapshot is what boots.
  """
  manifest: AgentBootstrapManifest

  """The cloud agent whose disk was captured."""
  sourceCloudAgentId: String!
}
